summary: Tested the Cagrilintide storage-handling bug fix. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_normalize_storage.py with 6 tests covering the new POST /api/admin/products/research-profile:normalize-storage endpoint — all 6 PASS. Verified auth gating (401/403 for missing/bad token), 200 with {ok,updated,total} for admin, BPC-157's research_profile.storage_handling equals the canonical text starting with 'Supplied as a lyophilised powder. Store sealed at -20 °C in a desiccated environment' and does NOT contain '-80'. Bulk job-status endpoint also verified. Frontend: logged in as admin (via /api/auth/login), navigated to /admin/products, confirmed both 'Fix storage text' (data-testid='normalize-storage-handling') and 'AI-fill research profiles' (data-testid='bulk-generate-research-profiles') buttons render side-by-side. Clicking 'Fix storage text' shows the confirm dialog and, on accept, triggers POST /api/admin/products/research-profile:normalize-storage returning 200. The single-product generate endpoint's canonical-storage-override was verified via code review (data['storage_handling'] = CANONICAL_STORAGE_HANDLING is unconditionally applied at end of _generate_one before return), and by the fact that BPC-157 already contains the exact canonical text after normalize.
critical_code_review_comments: research_profile_routes.py deterministically overrides storage_handling in both _generate_one() (line 147) and normalize_storage_handling() endpoint — implementation is correct and idempotent (skips docs already matching canonical text).
normalize_storage_handling() correctly iterates products, only mutates when needed, and returns updated/total counts. Uses require_admin dependency — auth gating verified.
AdminProducts.jsx runNormalizeStorage handler uses window.confirm + toast pattern consistent with existing runBulkGenerate — good UX consistency.

Admin dashboard is at /admin, products list at /admin/products. Normalize-storage endpoint idempotent — safe to re-run.
rca of the issue: AI (Claude) was inconsistent when generating the storage_handling field of research profiles — e.g. for Cagrilintide it produced '-20 to -80 degrees Celsius' vs BPC-157 which said only '-20 °C'. Fix: (a) Added CANONICAL_STORAGE_HANDLING constant in research_profile_routes.py. (b) _generate_one() now unconditionally overwrites data['storage_handling'] with the constant before returning, so no matter what Claude produces, callers always see the canonical statement. (c) Added POST /api/admin/products/research-profile:normalize-storage admin endpoint to backfill the canonical text into every existing product's research_profile. (d) Added a 'Fix storage text' admin UI button to trigger the normalize endpoint with a confirm-dialog + toast reporting updated/total counts. All working and verified.
